message:
Structural Dynamicist and Under-Deck Integration Designer, the device installs entirely from below with no deck closure and no drilling. The support is friction beam clamps to the girder bottom flanges carrying a cross-beam and the Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), a sprung mass moving out of phase, with total hung load 9.81 kN per the total static hung load TMD plus frame (E29), about thirteen adults and small against bridge mass, covered by one clamp pair rated 16 kN per the Type CF High Friction Clamp, Galvanised - Grampian Fasteners (E23).

The Manager and Under-Deck Integration Designer, the device survives outdoors and stays inspectable with the mass locked still. Hidden steel is hot-dip galvanized with zinc coating giving 20 to 50 years maintenance-free life per the Hot Dip Galvanized Material (E28), fitted with a lock-off pin that pins the 800 kg mass per the Size under-deck TMD mass tuning and damping for 1.9 Hz mode (E11) for inspection from a mobile lift below, plus locked nuts against detuning, which is normal hardware scale like scaffolding plant.

I veto any concept needing deck-level structures or deck appearance change. Not ready, because damped acceleration and stroke from Structural Dynamicist are still needed to freeze clamp loads and screen depth.
